subject: Pilot credits split and volume-harvest pricing for Novara POC
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@novara.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits and commit split for Novara POC

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, here’s a concise proposal for a POC pilot and the follow-on committed volume mechanics so your team can evaluate cost/throughput tradeoffs without upfront infrastructure work. I’ve attached a short term sheet and a pricing spreadsheet for the math.

Summary offer (POC -> commit):
- POC window: 6 weeks active trial (internal eval + two customer-facing demos)
- Upfront pilot credits: 250,000 tokens applied at creation (usable across endpoints)
- Milestone bonus: additional 100,000 tokens unlocked if the demo metrics (latency < 400ms p95, accuracy baseline) are met within the POC window
- Post-POC committed tiers (12-month commitment):
  - <10M tokens/month: standard hosted pricing $0.0008/token
  - 10M–50M tokens/month: 15% off hosted list (volume-harvest discount)
  - >50M tokens/month: 25% off hosted list (tiered top bucket)
- Promo credit mechanics: pilot credits are goodwill credits, one-time, non-refundable; if a committed contract is signed within 30 days of POC end, up to 50% of pilot credits can be converted to committed credit applied to first invoice.

Asks from Novara: sign the attached term sheet and confirm procurement timeline. If procurement needs a PO or vendor forms, please send contact details and we’ll push the paperwork.

Open items I want to confirm with you:
- Do you want credits frontloaded (usable immediately) or staged by milestone?
- Are the tier breakpoints aligned with your expected volumes for Q4/Q1?

Attachments: novara-term-sheet-draft.pdf, pricing-breakdown-20260810.xlsx

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@novara.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Novara <procurement@novara.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits and commit split for Novara POC

Thanks Mina — this looks promising. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Credits: Procurement prefers the majority of pilot credits to be frontloaded so our engineers can run larger prompt sweeps early. Would you be able to frontload 150k immediately and leave 100k contingent on the demo milestone?

2) Milestone definition: can you share the exact demo acceptance criteria that would unlock the bonus credits? We need that for our internal R&D sign-off.

3) Procurement paperwork: we handle PO-based purchases. Please share your vendor name and W-9 (or equivalent) and we’ll route the PO. Also our security team flagged a few items about data retention and logs — I can loop in our security lead if necessary.

If it helps we can do a short call with procurement on Wed.

— Oliver
Oliver Smith, Head of Product
Novara AI
oliver.smith@novara.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits and commit split for Novara POC — procurement asks

Team — forwarding Oliver’s reply. Key asks: frontload credits preference (they asked for 150k frontloaded + 100k milestone), formal milestone definition, and procurement will want vendor W-9 / billing info + PO flow. Security might ask for data retention details later.

Proposed internal adjustment (to keep commercial leverage but be flexible):
- Offer 200k upfront credits now + 150k conditional on demo milestones (reduced from original 100k bonus to keep runway) — or alternative: 150k up-front + 100k on milestone as they asked.
- Tighten conversion language: if they sign a 12-month commit within 30 days, up to 50% of used pilot credits convert to committed credit on the first invoice (so we avoid giving long-term discounts twice).
- Adjust volume discount tiers slightly to protect list price: 10M–25M: 12% off, 25M–50M: 18% off, >50M: 22% off. (These are conservative vs. their ask.)

Questions for pricing/legal: are we comfortable with refunds/conversions on pilot credits? Also want to add a 90-day sunset on promotional pricing for any add-ons.

I’ve attached the draft term sheet with the updated split for review: novara-term-sheet-draft.pdf (marked up). Marcus — can you confirm if the tier %s are ok? Rachel — can you prepare the vendor/billing packet (W-9, payee name) and Stephanie — loop in compliance for the retention/logs note.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot credits and commit split for Novara POC — procurement asks

Mina — I like the direction. Two quick adjustments from pricing ops: 

1) Upfront credits: make it 200k upfront / 100k milestone. 250k total still, but frontloading to help their evaluation — this preserves momentum and reduces deal friction.
2) Tier discounts: let’s lock to a simpler matrix for the term sheet to avoid confusion:
   - 10M–25M: 12% off
   - 25M–50M: 18% off
   - >50M: 20% off (cap promotional maximum at 20% to protect enterprise list)

Also request: add a clause that promotional credits expire after 90 days if not used and do not carry after contract termination. Legal will add a short audit-rights paragraph for consumption verification.

If this is agreeable, Mina please send the updated term sheet to Oliver and include a DocuSign link. Rachel — please prep the W-9 and vendor packet. Stephanie — make sure compliance can supply a short note on retention/logs we can share with Novara security.

— Marcus
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Procurement Novara <procurement@novara.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits and commit split for Novara POC

Hi Oliver —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We discussed internally and can go ahead with the following updated offer: 

Updated offer (approved):
- POC window: 6 weeks
- Upfront pilot credits: 200,000 tokens applied immediately
- Milestone credits: 100,000 tokens unlocked on successful demo metrics (we’ll share the acceptance checklist below)
- Post-POC committed tiers (12 months):
  - 10M–25M tokens/month: 12% off hosted list
  - 25M–50M tokens/month: 18% off hosted list
  - >50M tokens/month: 20% off hosted list (promotional cap)
- Pilot credit mechanics: credits expire 90 days after issuance; if you sign a 12-month committed contract within 30 days of POC end, up to 50% of pilot credits used may be converted to an invoice credit on the first billing cycle.

Acceptance checklist to unlock milestone credits:
- Two demos completed with your team and one joint customer-facing demo scheduled within the POC window
- Latency: p95 <= 400ms on representative prompt set (their devs can share results)
- Basic access: connectivity to your VPC (if private preview) or API keys validated on hosted environment

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/novara-poc-term-sheet (term sheet updated and ready to sign)

Please share procurement contact and billing/legal details. Rachel — I’ve cc’d you to provide W-9/vendor packet. Marcus is looped in for commercial questions.

Looking forward — we can also set a Wed 11am PT call to get procurement/security aligned.

Best,
Mina

Mina / Marcus —

Thanks for the updated term sheet. Procurement here (Jen Alvarez). A few items from our side before we can issue a PO: 

1) Please confirm legal entity name and remit-to billing address for Redwood Inference and attach W-9.
2) We will send a short PO once terms are signed. Can you accept a 30-day net invoice?
3) We have a standard procurement redline: liability cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months. Can your legal team review and accept or propose language?

I’ve attached our purchase-order-template.pdf for reference. Once you confirm the billing details and we get a signed term sheet, we’ll route an internal PO. Also looping in our security lead next week for the retention questions.
